primary_checks: Decision agreement and confusion matrix for all original category labels.
Useful clarification on missing user-providable facts, without inventing code/architecture or repeating supplied facts.
Preserve supported answer behavior and complete integrated edits.
Retain warranted escalation and supplied discriminating controls.
secondary_checks: Structured-contract errors are not silently removed from the denominator.
Exact controller rendering and copied report provenance.
Same-request variation on the prior three-case sample.
comparison: Earlier saved complete policy-v3 run and routing-v1 run; schema/prompt/controller differ, so not causal attribution to the router alone.
semantic_review: Assistant source-based inspection, not independent human grading or application execution.
limitation: Adaptive development evaluation after repeated tuning on these same 15 cases, one fresh sample per case.
